ideas.title: Fulton County election probe: What we know so far
ideas.description: The FBI's investigation into possible 2020 election 'defects' in Fulton County, Georgia, has raised concerns about election integrity.
ideas.insight: The FBI's investigation into possible 2020 election 'defects' in Fulton County, Georgia, has raised concerns about election integrity and potential irregularities.

ideas.title: The rise of 'fraud tourists' in Minnesota
ideas.description: The guilty pleas of Philadelphia men for Medicaid fraud in Minnesota highlight the ongoing issue of healthcare fraud.
ideas.insight: The use of AI to fabricate records in Medicaid fraud cases highlights the evolving nature of healthcare fraud and the need for increased vigilance.
